actual: scripts/issue_flow.py evaluate_pr_quality_gate classifies a PR as high-risk P0/P1 (is_high_risk) whenever linkage inference finds a bare BUG-NNN token in the PR body (re.findall BUG-\d{3,}), then with --enforce-p0-p1-evidence (AISTOCK_PR_QUALITY_ENFORCE_P0P1=true) blocks it (exit 2) if it lacks a linked bug issue. This false-positives on FEATURE/EPIC PRs that only REFERENCE a bug, e.g. the MiniQMT durable runtime epic PR #1523 (tracked by epic #1501) was blocked because its body said the runtime reuses 'BUG-470 status predicates' -- it does not fix a bug and has no linked bug issue, yet carries full evidence (tests/nox/gates).
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: scripts/issue_flow.py evaluate_pr_quality_gate marks a PR high-risk (is_high_risk) whenever linkage inference finds a bare BUG-NNN token in the PR body (line ~962 re.findall BUG-\d{3,}); with --enforce-p0-p1-evidence (AISTOCK_PR_QUALITY_ENFORCE_P0P1=true) it then blocks (exit 2) when the missing checks (typically linked_issue) are absent. FALSE-POSITIVE on feature/epic PRs that only REFERENCE a bug (MiniQMT durable runtime epic PR #1523, tracked by epic #1501, blocked because body said runtime reuses 'BUG-470 status predicates'; it fixes no bug, has no linked bug issue, yet carries full evidence). FIX: drive high-risk P0/P1 classification from ACTUAL bug-fix evidence -- changed files include a new/modified tests/aistock_validation/bugs/*.json OR the PR Closes a bug issue OR a linked bug record has explicit severity -- not a mere textual BUG-NNN mention; a feature/epic PR that only references a BUG-NNN -> not_applicable. MUST NOT weaken enforcement for real bug-fix PRs: regression tests BOTH directions (real bug PR missing evidence still blocked; feature PR referencing BUG-NNN is not_applicable). Pure tooling/CI change (scripts/issue_flow.py + tests); no product code; isolated from A epic and paper_v2 runtime.
